qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
qualification.details: PeopleSoft Campus Techno-Functional Specialist: Bachelor of Engineering (BE) or Master of Computer Applications (MCA) with minimum 3 years of experience in PeopleSoft Campus Solutions 9.0. Experience in implementation, support, and solution delivery. Experience working with medium to large higher education institutions. Strong background in systems analysis, database management, and project implementation.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Bangalore PeopleSoft Campus Techno-Functional Specialist Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Bangalore to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: PeopleSoft Campus Techno-Functional Specialist: Bachelor of Engineering (BE) or Master of Computer Applications (MCA) with minimum 3 years of experience in PeopleSoft Campus Solutions 9.0. Experience in implementation, support, and solution delivery. Experience working with medium to large higher education institutions. Strong background in systems analysis, database management, and project implementation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Bangalore PeopleSoft Campus Techno-Functional Specialist Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Bangalore to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM Bangalore) for filling up technical and functional positions in Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under IIM Bangalore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post advertised is PeopleSoft Campus Techno-Functional Specialist under advertisement number IIMB/HR/RECT/2026/54, offering a great opportunity for eligible professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the PeopleSoft Campus Techno-Functional Specialist post in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIM Bangalore recruitment is 09-10-2026. Candidates must apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Engineering (BE) or a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) along with relevant professional experience in PeopleSoft Campus Solutions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Nil, making it free for eligible applicants to apply for this government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC and ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, the application fee for SC and ST candidates is also Nil as per the official notification issued by the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PeopleSoft Campus Techno-Functional Specialist post primarily involves shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for IIM Bangalore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted through online mode only. Candidates should use the official portal or the direct application link provided.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section of this article and clicking on the designated download link.
